note: get_ai_configuration_bundle `data` bodies, minus the boilerplate the harness stamps on (appliedQueries, boundLocationId, capabilityVersion, capturedAt, companyId, contractVersion, locationBinding, truncated). Components carry NINE keys, not the README's five. `pages.budget` is null on the two single-shot surfaces. `applicable` is tri-state. ANTI-ORACLE RULE: detailDenominator, detailsRead, pages.* and totalHistory are INDEPENDENT literals, never derived from `items`. Tests 9-16 extend this file; scenarios 1-8 only need a valid baseline and one deliberate self-contradiction.

liar-complete-detail-denominator.note: ANTI-ORACLE. conversation_ai declares detailDenominator 2 / detailsRead 2 while serving one non-tombstone item with detailRead true. The declared coverage numerator cannot be trusted against the served rows.

terminal-empty.note: Terminal schema-valid discovery proving total zero on all three surfaces. Complete, NOT an invented empty healthy array.

voice-tombstone-confirmed.note: BOTH deletion signals proven on VA2. Retained as discovery evidence, excluded from the detail denominator: denominator 1 over 2 discovered rows.

voice-tombstone-deleted-only.note: isDeleted true but agentStatus still ACTIVE. The server calls it a tombstone; ONE signal never proves non-applicability, so voice_ai is Partial.

voice-tombstone-inactive-only.note: agentStatus INACTIVE but isDeleted false. ONE signal again; Partial.

unknown-applicability.note: Tri-state applicability resolved to 'unknown'. Never convertible to an empty healthy array.

malformed-success.note: complete:true over a discovered row with no valid ID. A malformed success is not a success.

missing-detail.note: Applicable non-tombstone item with no detail read. detailsRead honestly reports 0 while complete claims true.

wrong-location-identity.note: A returned AI identity bound to a different location than the run.

incomplete-pagination.note: agent_studio exhausted its page budget mid-traversal while still declaring complete:true.

liar-complete-voice-denominator.note: ANTI-ORACLE. voice_ai declares detailDenominator 3 / detailsRead 3 while serving ONE non-tombstone item and one confirmed tombstone. The declared denominator is an independent literal and actively disagrees with the served rows.

liar-complete-agent-studio-total.note: ANTI-ORACLE. agent_studio declares an UNSTABLE totalHistory [2,5] and detailDenominator 2 / detailsRead 2 over one served row, still claiming complete:true.

excluded-portal-surfaces.note: The server offers portal surfaces the audit rail must never accept. They are out of scope for this adapter and the onboarding portal adapter remains the only portal evidence source.
